page_description: ZeroOS is a minimalist, text-only Android home screen in black and white, with screen-time limits, focus mode and a short-video blocker.
seo_image_alt: The dotted ZeroOS wordmark next to the text-only home screen
hero_body: ZeroOS replaces your home screen with plain text in black and white. No icons, no badges, no feeds: only the time, the date and the few apps you choose.
hero_note: Free. Android 8.0 or newer. Installed from GitHub, not from an app store.
hero_screen_alt: The ZeroOS home screen: a large dotted clock, the date and battery, and four apps as plain text
look_body: Every screen uses one dotted typeface and two colours. These are real screens from the app, with sample apps and numbers.
look_hint: Swipe or scroll sideways for more
screen_home_body: Time, date and your favourite apps. Nothing else.
screen_home_alt: Home screen with a dotted clock and four favourite apps
screen_applist_body: Every app as text, A to Z, with search and a letter scroller.
screen_applist_alt: Alphabetical list of apps as plain text with a letter scroller
screen_focus_body: Pick a length and only the apps you allow can open.
screen_focus_alt: Focus picker with preset lengths and a Start focus button
screen_pause_body: A breath before the apps you limit, so opening them is a choice.
screen_pause_alt: Mindful pause screen with a dotted breathing animation
screen_shorts_body: Shorts and Reels can be blocked while the rest of each app still works.
screen_shorts_alt: Black screen over a short-video feed with a dotted play symbol and a pun
screen_insights_body: Today's screen time, your top apps and the last seven days, drawn in dots.
screen_insights_alt: Insights screen with screen time, top apps and a dotted weekly chart
screen_settings_body: Everything is a short list of plain words.
screen_settings_alt: Settings screen as a plain text list
feature_home_body: Large clock, date and battery, and up to ten favourite apps. No icons, badges or counters, and the home screen never scrolls.
feature_applist_body: Swipe up for every app, A to Z. Search by name or initials, hide apps you don't want to see and rename the ones you do.
feature_limits_body: Daily limits per app, a mindful pause before opening them, and a reminder to take a break after a long stretch.
feature_focus_body: Choose how long, choose the few apps that stay open, and, if you like, Do Not Disturb stays on until you're done.
feature_shorts_body: Blocks YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels at once or after a daily allowance. Off until you turn it on.
feature_insights_body: Screen time and unlocks on the home screen in one of four dotted styles, with a seven-day view.
feature_look_body: Light or dark, text sizes up to extra large, and black-and-white wallpapers. Works in portrait and landscape.
feature_private_body: No internet permission, no ads, no analytics and no accounts. Everything stays on your phone.
feature_backup_body: Save your settings to a file and bring them back on a new phone or after reinstalling.
feature_safe_body: If something keeps crashing, ZeroOS starts in a simple safe mode so your phone stays usable.
get_body: ZeroOS is downloaded from this project's GitHub Releases page and installed by hand. There is no app store version.

install_step_backup: Updating? In ZeroOS, export your settings first (Settings → Backup → Export settings).
install_step_download: Download the APK above on your Android phone and open it.
install_step_allow: If Android asks, allow your browser or file manager to install apps. Play Protect may warn about an app from outside the store; ZeroOS asks for an Accessibility service, which is optional and off by default.
install_step_home: Press Home and choose ZeroOS, or set it in Settings → Apps → Default apps → Home app.
install_step_back: To go back, choose your old launcher in the same Home app setting. Don't uninstall it.
